title: Grow one owned running LXC's memory
summary: Prepare a fixed guarded memory change with fresh identity, ownership, capacity and cgroup checks.

inspector.description: SHA-pinned native provider reference from the private environment

state_directory.description: Existing owner-only durable directory for intent, locks and private evidence

request.description: Exact node, LXC selector, trusted host fingerprints and actual ownership/generation tags

desired_memory_mb.description: Explicit desired memory ceiling; growth or already-desired only

capacity_policy.description: Observed available headroom and private minimum remaining bytes; not a capacity reservation

cmdmesh: 0.3.0 with schema2 operation support; use the catalog's exact core pin

expected_results: Planning reads current remote state, freezes private intent and returns a cmdmesh.procedure.plan bound to this operation's exact metadata
Separately approved CLI execution performs at most one guarded memory dispatch and independently checks configured and enforced memory
Known failure or unknown completion never becomes verified solely because Ansible exited zero or current checks pass

known_failures.summary: Observed ownership, generation or lifecycle control does not match the private request
next_checks: Inspect the native diagnostic receipt, actual guest tags and owning controller
recovery: Reconcile ownership outside this operation; never add tags merely to bypass refusal

known_failures.summary: Current reported capacity does not satisfy the explicit headroom policy
next_checks: Inspect current host memory, desired increase and private reserve
recovery: Resolve capacity or review a different explicit policy, then prepare a new plan

known_failures.summary: A bound input, source, baseline or runtime changed after preparation
next_checks: Compare phase receipts and current subject against the reviewed plan
recovery: Reconcile the change and prepare a new plan; do not rewrite the old frozen intent

known_failures.summary: Command completion, subject continuity or retained final evidence is unknown
next_checks: Read historical procedure status, private phase receipts and independent current host state
recovery: Retain state and reconcile before making another plan; never replay a consumed plan or shrink automatically

provenance.qualification: Actual core/native catalog planning with loopback TLS and synthetic SSH; core dispatch/postcheck failure contracts use synthetic targets
limitations: Successful real Proxmox growth, application availability and independent restore remain separately qualified milestones
Memory only: no swap, shrink, rootfs, restart, general workflow or automatic rollback
Shared durable local state coordinates participating controllers only; another machine or state directory is outside its lock
Declared prerequisites are not certification; input validation is local, full qualification happens during preparation and execution
